title: Vignette 2026-10-30: a human tip layer we can work without

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Owner, 2026-10-30: "There is room for a purely human controlled affirmation layer, but we should be able to work without it. The vignettes provide the lowest level input. 

Sometimes we will want to build a strongly managed human tip level. This is what affirmation does. Sometimes I might start there, sometimes it might get there eventually. But we don't always need it."

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-10-30; recorded verbatim.
